MANIFEST-SF-VECTOR-SYNC-4.2.product_title: StreamForge Real-Time Vector & Iceberg Lakehouse Sync v4.2
technical_highlights: Reduced p99 vector sync latency by 73.8% (from 145ms down to 38ms).
Sustains 250,000 rows/sec streaming throughput with 4.6x zero-copy delta compression.
Native connectors for BigQuery, Apache Iceberg, AlloyDB, Cloud Spanner.
